05 / OUR READING, FOR YOUR REVIEW

Two palettes to take further.

A recommendation for the next conversation.
No identity decisions have been finalized.

CONCEPT DIRECTION

C / Praise Ligature

The stronger whole-parish starting point: a memorable name-led shape, a broad visual footprint, and fewer fine internal divisions. Its editorial character and T/P separation still deserve refinement.

B remains a valuable expressive alternative if music should lead the identity. Its strings need a genuine small-size solution, not brighter color.

THE OPTIONAL THIRD CONCEPT

No third mark has been introduced. B and C already offer different structural ideas, and no stronger new symbol has been established that warrants replacing either during this color study.

Typography, final geometry, palette, and official two-logo arrangements remain open for your feedback.

Concept and production assessment
ConsiderationB / Sanctuary StringsC / Praise Ligature
Elegance & characterExpressive, curved, musical. Sanctuary is a quieter association.Sculpted, editorial, name-led. More classical than strictly modern.
Warmth & welcomeWorship and music give an immediate emotional cue.Open counters and warm neutrals soften a formal monogram.
MemorabilityRecognizable instrument silhouette; could suggest a choir.Clear connection to the name; T/P monograms are crowded territory.
Print & signageUse primary/neutral and sufficiently generous scale. Test strings on actual material.Broader shapes are promising; proof the narrow letter channel.
Web & social16px remains a diagnostic weakness. 32–64px gives strings more room.Stronger small silhouette; 16px still needs a refined micro version.
Official RCCG pairingIndependent mark; a separate neutral-backed emblem is reserved.Compact monogram can balance a separate emblem. Actual asset test pending.
